llm.summary: The skill is a coherent email-automation helper, but it gives an agent broad mailbox mutation, sending, and webhook-routing powers without enough user-control guidance.

dimensions.detail: The required MAILS_API_URL, MAILS_AUTH_TOKEN, and MAILS_MAILBOX are expected for the described API access, but they expose mailbox contents, verification codes, attachments, and outbound mail authority to the agent.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The artifact is a single Markdown skill with no bundled executable scripts, binaries, dependency installation, or local tool modification.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The common inbox flow directs reading an email and then deleting it, and webhook/sending flows are not scoped by recipient, destination domain, retention rule, or confirmation step.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: No local system persistence is present, but the skill documents persistent remote mailbox setting and webhook route changes without lifecycle or approval guidance.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: Receiving verification codes, reading/searching mail, sending replies, attachments, extraction, and mailbox management fit the stated email automation purpose and are disclosed.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Review before installing if this mailbox may receive important records or account-recovery messages. Use a dedicated low-risk mailbox, restrict who can use the token, require confirmation before deletes or webhook changes, and avoid forwarding verification codes or mailbox contents to untrusted destinations.
llm.findings:
[TM1] expected: The DELETE email endpoint is disclosed and fits mailbox management, but the artifact normalizes deletion after reading without confirmation, retention criteria, or safer archive semantics.
[SQP-2] expected: Outbound sending and webhook configuration are advertised capabilities, but the skill does not limit recipients or webhook destinations or warn against forwarding sensitive mailbox contents or verification codes.
[SQP-2] expected: Deletion of emails and attachments is documented, but the instructions do not explain data-loss consequences or require explicit user authorization before destructive actions.
